Position Title: Software Engineer (3) - Core Engineer 3

CTC: 25LPA

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. • Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development

Position Title: Software Engineer (3) - Core Engineer 3

CTC: 25LPA

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

Position Title: Software Engineer (3) - Core Engineer 3

CTC: 25LPA

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

Position Title: Software Engineer (3) - Core Engineer 3

CTC: 25LPA

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

Position Title: Software Engineer (3) - Core Engineer 3

CTC: 25LPA

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development

Assist in automating routine tasks and processes to reduce human errors.

Position Description:

About the Role We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Power Platform Software Engineer to join our Global Source to Contract team. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing, optimizing, and automating our core business processes. You will support a diverse, global user base by transforming legacy SharePoint-based processes into highly efficient, modern applications. This is an exciting opportunity to lead a major migration of our existing solution suite to a new environment, refactoring and enhancing the codebase to modern standards. Additionally, you will drive innovation by integrating Microsoft Copilot and Generative AI capabilities to deliver an intelligent, next-generation user experience. You will join a fast-paced, highly collaborative Agile team (typically 5-6 developers) that is recognized for rapid development and continuous innovation.

Skills Required:

AI, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Python, GCP, Big Query,

Skills Preferred:

Microsoft Sharepoint Technical Experience

• Power Platform Expertise: 35+ years of hands-on experience developing enterprise-level Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven) and Power Automate flows.

• AI & Copilot Experience: Proven experience integrating Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder, or Azure OpenAI services within the Power Platform ecosystem.

• Data Architecture: Strong experience with Microsoft Dataverse (formerly Common Data Service), SharePoint Online, SQL Server, and configuring On-Premises Data Gateways.

• Azure & API Integration: Experience extending Power Platform capabilities using Azure API Apps, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and consuming RESTful APIs.

• DevOps & ALM: Experience using Azure DevOps (ADO) for task tracking, source control, and setting up Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) pipelines for Power Platform solutions.

• Agile Methodology: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile/Scrum environment as a self-starter who can quickly adapt to changing priorities. Professional & Soft Skills

• Strong UX/UI design sensibility with a track record of building clean, user-friendly mobile and desktop interfaces.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical architectures, write user guides, and deliver engaging solution demonstrations to non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven ability to estimate work accurately, meet planned timelines, and manage competing priorities.

Experience Required:

Engineer 3 Exp: Proficient In 2 coding lang. or adv. Prac. in 1 lang. 6+ years in IT; 4+ years in development




Preferred Certifications

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)

• Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Functional Consultant (PL-200)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or

Power Platform App Maker (PL-100) is a strong plus.

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start Caring. Connecting. Growing together.
The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is a software-driven operations engineer responsible for improving the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of cloud-based systems.
As a Junior SRE, you will support the design, implementation, and operation of cloud platforms on GCP and Azure, working closely with development, platform, and security teams. You will contribute to automation, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and incident response while continuously building expertise in DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
Primary Responsibilities:
Cloud Infrastructure & Reliability
Assist in provisioning and managing cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code tools (e.g., Terraform)
Support high availability, scalability, and resilience patterns
Help monitor SLIs/SLOs and improve system reliability
Participate in capacity planning and performance testing
Monitoring & Incident Response
Configure monitoring and alerting (Azure Monitor, GCP Ops, Prometheus, Grafana)
Participate in on-call rotations and incident handling
Assist in troubleshooting and root cause analysis
CI/CD & GitOps
Support CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
Implement automated build, test, and deployment workflows
Follow Git best practices and contribute to GitOps adoption
DevSecOps
Assist with security scans and vulnerability remediation
Work with secret management tools (Key Vault, Secret Manager)
Ensure compliance with security standards
Automation & Operations
Develop automation scripts (Python, Bash, PowerShell)
Maintain runbooks and documentation
Support deployments and operational tasks
Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions using no-code, low-code, and advanced platforms, translating business needs into scalable applications that enhance products, workflows, and decision-making.
Required Qualifications:
3+ years in SRE / DevOps / Cloud Engineering
Knowledge of Cloud platforms: Azure or GCP
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
Knowledge of Scripting: Python / Shell
Knowledge of CI/CD tools
Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools
Proven problem solving and troubleshooting
Proven solid communication skills
Proven automation-first mindset
Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments
At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.
